remaining_cautions.evidence_context: The 12.5/25 µM planktonic MIC values are stated in the article as prior-work values and are retained with provenance; current-paper high-density MIC rows are kept separate.

The local supplementary files are Nature article HTML landing captures; XML names PDF/TIF/AVI supplementary media, but those true media files are not present in the local packet. Main XML/PDF evidence is sufficient for the repaired owner layers.
Biofilm and mechanism figures contain dose-response/fluorescence detail not available as structured local tables; only text-supported numeric values and qualitative claims are promoted.
NDBP-5.7 is recorded as the C-terminal amidated sequence reported by the source and is not normalized to an unmodified peptide.
